name: Upload accepts a CSV and reports a broken file

planSteps.description: Navigate to the upload page: http://127.0.0.1:8501/upload

Set the file input to a file named 'sales.csv' whose UTF-8 content is exactly:
Order ID,Order Date,Customer Name,Region,Qty.,Revenue
ORD-1,09/01/2026,Acme Inc,north,2,"$1,240.00"
ORD-2,2026-09-02,Beta Co,south,3,"€ 3.040,00"
ORD-3,31/09/2026,Gamma Ltd,north,4,not available
A section titled 'Files ready to process' appears listing the file 'sales.csv' with its row count (3 rows) and column count (6 columns).

Additionally set the same file input to a second file named 'broken.csv' whose content is:
Order ID,Order Date,Customer Name
ORD-1,09/01/2026,Acme Inc
ORD-2,2026-09-02
An error message appears showing the filename 'broken.csv' and the text 'could not be read' (plain-language error, no traceback).
A primary button labeled 'Continue to column mapping →' is visible.
